The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 734e4050dc8416c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. statement: The auxiliary tuples Ri can be chosen with the following properties. The construction permits one prescribed sequence among their entries, provided that it satisfies the varying-support and cyclic-quotient conditions above, splits on W and in the fixed twisting field, and has a limiting Tate Frobenius matrix of determinant one and trace different from two. The complex C+ ⊗B B(2) is a free module of rank two in degree one, up to homotopy. Generically over B, the tensor a ∧ z is nonzero and gives a coordinate Uraw ∈ Frac B relative to a generator of D(C+). In a simultaneous twist comparison the generator is inherited from the common diagram before the two character evaluations. The tensor is independent of the positive lift of z after passing to the fraction field. Define the normalized coordinate by U = Uraw ∆ Y q∈Sf q̸=2 Dq Pq , Dq = det(1 − χ(Frq)ρT (Frq)/q | VIq ). (L1) Here Iq indicates inertia and the subscript in VIq takes coinvariants. Pq is the actual local inverse L-polynomial at 1 of the curve being tested with the unramified scalar twist in the period-law orientation. ∆ is the smoothing factor of (K4) with the actual field weight including the fixed character if present. All exponents in this formula are the limiting exponents. There is no D/P correction for a moving place. The assertion is that U ∈ B\{0}. If the construction is made simultaneously for E′ and a positive fundamental twist E′(h), the two reductions of U differ by a unit of B/2B. In particular, they are simultaneously units at the closed point.
